recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片細胞量多，幾乎整個視野都是含粉紫顆粒的成熟中顆粒球（骨髓球、後骨髓球、帶狀核），而深藍細胞質、圓形深染核的紅血球前驅細胞很少，代表骨髓球/紅血球比（M:E ratio）上升。
features: Cellular aspirate dominated by granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation
Many myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band neutrophils with granular pink-lilac cytoplasm
Erythroid precursors (round dense nuclei, deep blue to polychromatic cytoplasm) are relatively few
Orderly maturation without an obvious excess of blasts at this power
Occasional eosinophil precursors; thick crenated red cell background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and composed predominantly of granulocytic cells showing orderly maturation from myelocytes to segmented neutrophils. Erythroid precursors are relatively scarce, resulting in an increased myeloid-to-erythroid ratio. Blasts are not increased at this magnification, and no significant dysplasia is evident. Findings are consistent with an increased M:E ratio, which may reflect granulocytic hyperplasia (infection, inflammation, G-CSF) or erythroid hypoplasia; a CML or other MPN should be excluded clinically and by blood counts.

ddx.vs: CML shows a markedly increased M:E ratio with myelocyte and segmented neutrophil peaks, basophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes, confirmed by BCR::ABL1.
PRCA has almost absent erythroid precursors with normal granulopoiesis, so the increased M:E is due to erythroid loss rather than myeloid expansion.
AML with maturation shows 20% or more blasts, often with Auer rods, which are not seen here.
